GOV-F-003-S129.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S129.description: Define the Brain lock data schema including lock_id, owner_id, TTL, heartbeat timestamp, and status fields. Establish contract rules for ownership, expiration, and renewal semantics to ensure consistent enforcement across services.

GOV-F-003-S130.title: Brain Lock API for Acquire, Heartbeat, and Release
GOV-F-003-S130.description: Implement backend API endpoints or service methods for acquiring a lock, renewing via heartbeat, releasing ownership, and querying lock state. Ensure APIs enforce TTL rules and ownership validation.
